SRI LANKA EXPORT DEVELOPMENT ACT, No. 40 OF 1979
Order under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 14(2) of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979, I, MalikSamarawickrama, Minister of Development Strategies and International Trade, with the concurrence of the Minister ofFinance, do by this Order rescind the amount of CESS specified in the corresponding entry in Column IV in the Scheduleto the Extraordinary Gazette No. 2047/2 dated November 27, 2017, in respect of the article specified in the Schedulehereto, with effect from March 6, 2019.
MALIK SAMARAWICKRAMA,Minister of Development Strategiesand International TradeMinister of Development Strategies and International Trade,Colombo 01,March 05, 2018.
